Memorandum and Proposed Regulation Changes with Initial Statement of Reasons
The State Historic Rehabilitation Tax Credit Regulations were filed with the Secretary of State and became effective on November 12, 2024.
CTCAC State Historic Rehabilitation Tax Credit Regulations (November 12, 2024)
Application instructions, application forms, frequently asked questions and OHP program regulations can be found on the OHP website at State Historic Rehabilitation Tax Credit (ca.gov).
Applications will be accepted beginning at 8:00 a.m., Monday January 6, 2025.
